correctness.rationale: The proof separates the Hermitian terminal-invisible eigenspace from the exponentially decaying finite-dimensional complement under strictly positive sink rates; uses exact Dirichlet sine eigenmodes and two boundary equations; groups coefficients by path-mode parity; and derives a closed gcd inclusion-exclusion dimension, if-and-only-if capture criterion and full localized projector. The displayed groups and normalization are exact. A separate spectral eigenspace reconstruction matched 343 graph triples (4116 internal vertices) and independent non-Hermitian matrix exponentials matched 282 site values for 28 unequal-rate Hamiltonians. These calculations corroborate an analytic proof and are not assumed to prove infinite ranges.
